name: humanic
description: Plan, draft, review, and analyze AI-powered email marketing campaigns and cohorts in Humanic. Includes a guided workflow that never sends real emails without explicit confirmation.

interface.longDescription: Connect to your Humanic organization to inspect cohorts, draft email campaigns, review content and sender settings, and read campaign analytics. Drafting is always safe: campaigns are only activated, which sends real emails, after you explicitly confirm. Humanic only accesses the organization behind the account you sign in with.
defaultPrompt: Show my Humanic organization and available cohorts.
Draft a campaign for one of my cohorts and let me review it.
Summarize analytics for my most recent campaign.
